test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Without assuming anything beyond the information given, select the correct nature of relationship between the two events A and B. 

Event A : Ronit went to the dentist.

Event B : Ronit had a toothache.

options.text: Event A is the effect but event B is not its immediate and principal cause.
Event B is the effect and event A is its immediate and principal cause.
Event B is the effect but event A is not its immediate and principal cause.
Event A is the effect and event B is its immediate and principal cause.

solution:
The correct answer is option "**4**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Ronit went to dentist because he had a toothache .
 
• Here it is clear that Ronit went to dentist because he had a toothache.
 
• So the event A is the effect and event B is its immediate and principal cause.
